name: MKT_RM_RESP_ITEM_ASSOC
description: This table stores references to the product or product groups associated with a marketing response.

columns.name: PROD_ASSOC_ID
columns.description: Product Association id. Primary key.

columns.name: AMOUNT
columns.description: Amount for Products

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: RESPONSE_ID
columns.description: Response id.

columns.name: INVENTORY_ITEM_ID
columns.description: Item id.

columns.name: PRIMARY_FLAG
columns.description: Primary flag.

columns.name: INV_ORG_ID
columns.description: Inventory organization id.

columns.name: PROD_GROUP_ID
columns.description: Product group id.

columns.name: QUANTITY
columns.description: Product Quantity

columns.name: UOM_CODE
columns.description: Unit of measure code for product

columns.name: ESTIMATED_UNIT_PRICE
columns.description: Estimated Unit Price for the product

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Currency code for the product

columns.name: CONV_CURR_CODE
columns.description: Conversion Currency Code. Stores the CRM Corporate Currency Code used for conversion.

columns.name: CONV_RATE_TYPE
columns.description: Conversion Rate Type. Stores the rate type for  deriving the exchange rate which will be used to convert user entered currency into CRM corporate currency .

columns.name: CONV_EXCHANGE_RATE
columns.description: Conversion Exchange Rate. Stores the currency exchange rate used for converting the user entered currency into CRM corporate currency.
